summary: Local macOS test-only fixed-grid QR comparison, quantizing original-column coefficients during triangular backsolve instead of independently after a continuous solve. Twelve control/beam tests retain 130 original configurations (seven successes, 123 residual failures) and 72 additional anchor/sign/numbering configurations (38 accepted, 30 residual rejections, four norm rejections). Reverse-order quantization qualifies the tiny-coordinate first-mode candidate at 6.358818e-9 with radius 65536. Accepted f64 shapes retain their eigenvalue/frozen anchor and pass independent physical reassembly, unit norm and constructed result JSON readback. A separate unit-shape wrapper rejects candidates whose physical gate passes but norm drifts, without renormalizing or modifying the production path. Renumbering changes successful orders, so generic ordering robustness remains unproven. Closed-entry integer/representable-target checks, four bounded passes, at most six true certificates per independent fit, final rejection, residual refresh and cancellation/replay are verified. This is candidate and publication-boundary evidence, not runtime admission, a global integer optimum, aggregate multi-fit budgets, measured performance, multimode or live Agent/installed/remote execution.

required_text: This is test-only quantized grid candidate evidence, not new runtime admission or general modal qualification.
